data.name: Chaoslands
data.detailed_description:
This game is a pixel-styled, turn-based sandbox game. The player can explore the world, collect resources, build a city, and fight bosses. There are several biomes that can be entered with different features. There are 100 obstacles ranging from trees to bosses. Some of them can be built like a town hall or farmlands. 50 items can be obtained, for example, tools, plants, or weapons, to progress in the game. Big constructions can be built using different buildings and grounds. There is space for your creativity. Ships can be built to cross water. The caves can be entered through a mine where silver and gold can be found. Structures are around the world, and 5 quest lines have to be finished to complete the game and exit the planet. The story is as follows.

You have the mission to visite a planet from your mothership to buy compressed food for the journey. During landing your rocket breaks in parts and you have to repair it. Good for you that the residents on this planet have the needed parts to repair the rocket. Complete their quests to return to your mothership.

data.short_description: This game is a pixel-styled, turn-based sandbox game. Collect around 50 items and build or find 100 obstacles accross the world. Build ships to cross water and enter the caves to collect advanced resources. Fight 2 bosses and level up.
